a1.title: The Narrow Beam
a1.note: the seven trusts now drift home and draw the shy one's own portrait — you were tracing it all along; it meets the half-light gold ever after

b1.title: Didn't You Notice
b1.note: it ends now: every 12 skies a quiet coda counts what slid by; sizes shrink too — one pair of real ears from bloom

c1.title: One Thing
c1.note: from round 6 the voice lies too — a calm false fifth far away that must get worse before it binds; overrule your ear

d1.title: Seeing With Your Ears
d1.note: the room grows bones: interior walls you hear four ways — a band of quiet, a wooden double-knock, a soft stop, one echo-timed glint

a2.title: Trust the Feeling
a2.note: rare flash rounds now take the commit from your hand in one second, and the mirror compares each nine to the last

b2.title: Below the Line
b2.note: the noise-mouth grew consonants — frost snaps into being f-first — and the reveal now warns the pushes sank

c2.title: The Guessing Machine
c2.note: bloom: a firm hand can outvote the whisper, and the coda says stop — watch the bright afterlife thin until only the stings are the world

d2.title: What Red Sounds Like
d2.note: bloom: the coda names the closest and most-lost crossing, and touching any pair replays it — two tones overlapping in the air

a3.title: Where I End
a3.note: the ending exists: grow wide enough and the border dissolves into the room — and a self that returns small keeps a faint breath

b3.title: Two Minds
b3.note: a tenth round that doesn't exist: the left hand acts alone and the voice takes the credit — the reason arrives unasked

c3.title: The Inward Ear
c3.note: bloom: long after the last line the piece recedes to the edge of hearing — what's left breathing in the near-dark is you

d3.title: Who You Were
d3.note: the return is recognition now — your dim spiral waits at the gate before you prove it, and long selves coil tight instead of leaving the screen

a4.title: The Width of Now
a4.note: measured, not just heard: no delay buildup, and the strum now breathes with W — a wide now unrolls its chord as a slow gesture

b4.title: Did I Do That?
b4.note: bloom: the reveal now draws your seam — every late act a mark on the delay axis, and a dashed line where yours came loose

c4.title: The River
c4.note: bloom: a thought heard to its last word is never lost to timing now — letting go completes it; the piece is finished, let it run

d4.title: Catch Yourself
d4.note: it remembers now: catches persist across sittings, checking in is kind, and the plant's motes gather home at bloom
